summary: PHA 1 khao sat 12 moi truong family tren Revit 2026 that: phat hien Revit co HAI THE GIOI dung hinh ROI NHAU (SKETCH dung FamilyItemFactory, ADAPTIVE/MASSING dung Form + diem thich ung) va chung LOAI TRU nhau — NewExtrusion nem InvalidOperationException trong family adaptive, NewReferencePoint nem FamilyContextException trong family thuong. Mo duoc 12/12 template. PHA 2 dung 4 family bang 4 phep khac nhau, kiem doc lap bang cach mo lai: DotVanhVom (SweptBlend path CONG, Structural Framing), ThanTruThuon (Blend, Structural Columns, 163.000 m3 khop cong thuc prismatoid den tung chu so), BeMong (Extrusion + void, Structural Foundations), AdaptiveHaiDiem (SweptBlendForm, FLEX dat). PHA 3 sinh 74 family theo tiet dien roi lap 621 instance adaptive thanh cau hoan chinh; bao cua ban FAMILY TRUNG KHIT ban DirectShape doi chieu: x -34..214, y -22..22, z -30..67.23. Kem thu vien bridge_evolution/revit_family/ ma hoa moi rang buoc DA DO thanh kiem tra fail-closed, 212 test xanh, chay duoc khi Revit tat.
assumptions: Moi ket qua do tren Revit 2026.4 May nay, template he met trong C:\ProgramData\Autodesk\RVT 2026\Family Templates\English. Chua kiem tren phien ban Revit khac hay may khac.
Toa do lay tu tmp/arch_massing/bars.json (621 thanh, 24 nhom, sha16 186eefc7502ac274) — do la KHOI HINH THAI F0 IDEA, khong phai thiet ke. Family dep va tham so hoa KHONG nang muc claim.
74 family duoc key theo (rong, cao). Tiet dien co dinh moi family; bien thien tiet dien doc theo mot cau kien chua duoc tham so hoa theo instance.
